resources.text: Below the distant clouds, there is a green grassland covered with soft grass. A group of care - free little sheep live on the grassland.
Among them, there is a little sheep named Pengpeng. It has fluffy wool, as soft as the clouds in the sky.
Pengpeng is not only kind and lovely but also very brave. There is always a glimmer of yearning for the distance in its eyes.
The old sheep on the grassland often tell an ancient legend:
Deep in the mysterious restricted area above the clouds, there grows a magical rainbow grass.
This grass has the magic to fulfill wishes and can also endow the guardian with powerful strength.
As long as one passes all the trials and eats the rainbow grass, one can transform into the supreme Cloud King and protect a region.
Pengpeng grew up listening to this legend. A big dream was planted in its heart - to become the Cloud King who protects everyone.
Finally, one day, Pengpeng bid farewell to its warm home and dear family, and set off on an adventurous journey full of unknowns and challenges with its head held high.
Now, brave young readers, let's start this wonderful adventure of the Cloud King with Pengpeng!
At each node, you need to make a choice. Different choices will lead to different endings!

Standing upright on the high slope of the grassland with its front hooves slightly raised, ready to take a step: Now, brave young readers, let's start this wonderful adventure of the Cloud King with Pengpeng!

Pengpeng walked out of its familiar home. The gentle breeze gently blew through its fluffy wool, and the sun shone warmly on its body. Two completely different paths appeared ahead. One led to the fog - shrouded restricted area, and the other led to the sparkling seaside.
Pengpeng stopped and tilted its little head. It asked the wind spirit beside it:
Wind spirit, wind spirit, which path should I take?
Pengpeng, one is the main route to the restricted area, and the other is the side route to the seabed. You choose for yourself!
I'm going to the restricted area to find the rainbow grass and become the Cloud King!
Good job! Stick to your goal and don't be tempted by distractions!
Firmly walk towards the restricted area, ignoring the scenery by the roadside

Pengpeng stuck to its goal and was not distracted by the roadside scenery. It walked straight towards the restricted area where the rainbow grass was said to be hidden. The entrance of the restricted area was covered with a thin layer of fog, like a mysterious veil. Pengpeng took a deep breath and bravely stepped in, officially starting the adventure to find the sacred object.
Wow, it's so mysterious inside the restricted area! I have to be careful!
Its figure was gradually swallowed by the fog, and it took a last look back
Take a deep breath and bravely step into the entrance of the restricted area
After entering the restricted area, look around and move forward carefully: Wow, it's so mysterious inside the restricted area! I have to be careful!
After successfully entering the restricted area, the fog gradually dispersed, and the road ahead became clear.
Pengpeng found two items quietly placed on the bluestone at the intersection -
A map showing the route and a basket of fresh fruits emitting a sweet smell.
Grandpa Map gently said:
I'm the map. I can guide you in the right direction!
Fruit Sister blinks her eyes:
I'm a fruit. I'm sweet and delicious. Eating me can replenish your energy!
Pengpeng tilts his head and falls into deep thought.
The seabed looks so beautiful! I want to go and have a look!
Oh dear, there are many dangers on the seabed. You'll get lost!
It doesn't matter. I just want to take a quick look!
Pengpeng is attracted by the mysterious underwater world and deviates from the main route into the deep sea.
Although the seabed is beautiful, it's full of dangers and undercurrents are surging.
Woo, it's so dark here. I can't find my way...
Little lamb, little lamb, why did you come here? It's very dangerous here!
I want to go home. I want to continue looking for the rainbow grass...
Go back quickly! Choose again on land!
Grandpa Map, I need your help!
Good boy, I'll always guide you forward!
Thank you, Grandpa Map! I won't disappoint you!
Pengpeng remembers what the old sheep said. The roads deep in the forbidden area are complex. You must have a guide to avoid getting lost.
Without hesitation, it picks up the map that guides the direction. The symbols on the map are shining, as if silently guiding it.
Pengpeng carefully holds the map in his arms and continues to go deeper into the forbidden area based on the clues, getting closer to the goal.
With the map, I won't get lost! Let's go!
Clasping his fists in front of his chest and leaning forward slightly: Grandpa Map, I need your help!
The parchment unfolds slightly, and the symbols shine with a flowing light: Good boy, I'll always guide you forward!
Nodding vigorously, with hands hanging naturally and then making fists: Thank you, Grandpa Map! I won't disappoint you!
Looking down at the map in his arms, gently stroking the paper with his fingers, then looking up: With the map, I won't get lost! Let's go!
Running forward in big strides, tightly holding the map in front of his chest, with his tail up: With the map, I won't get lost! Let's go!
--- Blue fire leads the way, and the crocodile river ferries the kind ---
--- The third choice: Guided by the flame ---
Ponpon, holding a map, slowly walked along the path.
After walking for a short while, two strange flames suddenly appeared in front of him -
One was a gentle and serene blue flame, like the starlight at night;
One was a passionate and dazzling red flame, like a dancing fire.
The blue flame said gently:
Suddenly stopping, looking up and staring ahead, the map slipped half an inch from his hand
I am the guide of justice. Follow me, and you will get protection.
The red flame shouted impatiently:
I am the symbol of power. Follow me, and you will become strong!
The two flames illuminated two different paths, and Ponpon needed to make a choice.

branches.label: Move forward according to the blue flame

resources.text: Wow, the fruits look so delicious! I want to eat them!
Come and eat! It'll surely leave you with a lingering aftertaste!
Ponpon, don't eat them! You'll lose your strength if you do!
Never mind! I'm so hungry!
Ponpon was tempted by the sweet fruits and picked them up to eat greedily.
Right after finishing eating, his body suddenly began to degenerate. He lost all his strength and turned into a weak lamb.
Woohoo, my strength is gone... I can't walk anymore...
The lamb propped up on its front hooves, trembling, and its lips moved as it whimpered: I can't walk anymore...
Alas, if you don't listen to the elders, you'll surely suffer later!
Sister Blue Flame, you look so gentle. I trust you!
Thank you for your trust, brave little lamb!
Humph, you don't know what's good! You should follow me!
Ponpon looked at the gentle blue flame and thought it was warm and reassuring. It must be the guide of justice.
It closely followed the steps of the blue flame and stepped onto the right path forward.
Miraculously, since stepping on this path, the surrounding air became gentle. It seemed to be protected by a mysterious power, and the journey was safe and smooth all the way.
Put down the map and step forward to follow the blue flame onto the left - hand path
Sister Blue Flame, thank you for protecting me!
You're welcome. Keep going! The Rainbow Grass is right ahead!
Standing still, looking into the distance, hooves slightly clenched

After following the blue flame for a while, Pengpeng came to a fork in the road. To the left was a quiet western path, and to the right was an open eastern avenue. The blue flame was gently flickering in the eastern direction, as if constantly calling to it.
Pengpeng, go east! The east is the right way!
A mysterious voice came from the western path:
Come to me. I have treasures here!
Brother Red Fire, you look so powerful. I'll follow you!
Hahaha, come on! I'll take you flying!
Run towards the red flame at full speed, with arms outstretched
Pengpeng, don't go there! He's dangerous!
Suddenly stop in your tracks and turn your head towards the blue flame
I want to become strong!
Pengpeng was attracted by the bright and intense red flame. Thinking it was more powerful, he didn't hesitate to get closer.
As soon as he touched it, he was directly pushed out of the forbidden area by a powerful and violent force, and the map was blown away by the wind.
Ouch! It hurts so much! My map is gone!
Hahaha, weak sheep don't deserve power at all!
Pengpeng, come back and make a new choice!
You've chosen: Go west!
Treasures? I have to go and see!
Pengpeng, don't go! There's a big boss in the west!
The treasures must be very precious. I have to go!

Pengpeng was curious about the quiet western path and thought the eastern avenue was too ordinary. So, ignoring the guidance of the blue flame, he walked west. Suddenly, a powerful boss jumped out halfway. It was huge and menacing.
Roar! Little fat sheep, how dare you intrude into my territory!
Ah! Monster! Help!
Flung away by the giant claw, rolling and falling to the ground, struggling to get up and then falling again: Ah! Monster! Help!
Alas, you didn't listen to the advice and got beaten, right!
Sister Blue Flame, I'll follow your advice and go east!
Great! Hold on, you're getting closer to success!
Humph, you don't know what's good. You don't even want the treasure!

Pengpeng remembered the guidance of the blue flame and wasn't tempted by the path to the west. He firmly walked east. The road to the east was very smooth, and colorful little flowers bloomed by the roadside. The sun shone through the clouds, warm and comfortable. Pengpeng took brisk steps and continued to approach the rainbow grass.
The scenery here is so beautiful! Come on, Pengpeng!
Looking up at the front, clenching his fists to encourage himself: Come on, Pengpeng!
Standing at the crossroads, turning to face the east, taking a deep breath and then taking the first step
Walking briskly along the eastern avenue with natural arm swings: Pengpeng: The scenery here is so beautiful! Come on, Pengpeng!
Continuing to walk forward, looking firmly into the distance
After reaching the safe area in the east, two brand - new paths appeared in front of Pengpeng: one led to the gurgling Crocodile River, and the other led to the misty mysterious maze.
The Crocodile River gurgled:
I'm the only way to the rainbow grass. Come on, brave one!
The mysterious maze whispered softly:
I'm full of surprises. Come in and explore!

branches.label: Walking to the river with crocodiles

resources.text: I want to be the King of the Clouds. I'm not afraid of any difficulties!
What courage! Get ready to take the river - crossing test!
Humph, coward, too scared to explore!

Pengpeng remembered the instructions in the legend and knew that the Crocodile River was the only way to the rainbow grass. Even though he knew there were fierce crocodiles in the river, he didn't back down. Pengpeng summoned up his courage, chose to walk towards the Crocodile River, and prepared to take the ultimate river - crossing test.
Mr. Crocodile, here I come! Please give me some advice!
Suddenly turning back, looking at the crocodile with burning eyes: Please give me some advice!
Taking a deep breath, puffing out his chest, standing firmly on the riverbank, and putting his right fist on his chest: Mr. Crocodile, here I come!
Slowly floating to the surface, slightly raising his eyelids and spouting a water column from his nostrils: Please give me some advice!
Taking a firm step forward, testing the water with his toes and leaning forward slightly
Suddenly wagging his tail, fully showing his body, opening his huge mouth and then slowly closing it, indicating the start of the river - crossing
Arriving at the Crocodile River, the water was clear but swift
A huge crocodile was lying quietly in the middle of the river. Its hard scales glistened, blocking all the paths forward.
The crocodile opened its eyes, looked at the little lamb in front of it, said nothing and didn't attack.
Little one, you want to cross the river?
Yes, Mr. Crocodile, I'm going to look for the rainbow grass!
Then how do you plan to get there?
Pengpeng has to choose a way to cross the river to continue moving forward.

branches.label: Step on the crocodile's head to cross the river

resources.text: The maze looks so interesting! I'm going to play in it!
Maze: Hahaha, come in! You'll never get out!
Crocodile River: Pengpeng, don't go in! You'll exhaust your energy inside!
I'll just play for a while!
Pengpeng is full of curiosity about the mysterious maze. He thinks there must be treasures hidden in it, so he abandons the main path and strays into the maze.
The internal paths of the maze are intricate, with one fork after another and identical walls everywhere.
Hey, I've walked on this path before...
I'm so tired. I can't walk anymore...
Woo, I really want to get out...
Pengpeng keeps running inside, going around in circles. His energy is gradually exhausted, and finally he collapses from exhaustion and can't stand up anymore.

branches.label: Choose the river with crocodiles again

resources.text: Mr. Crocodile, I want to become the King of the Clouds and protect my family and friends on the grassland.
So I have to cross this river to look for the rainbow grass.
I have no ill intentions. I just want to fulfill my dream of protection. Please help me.
Do you really want to protect everyone? Not for your own power?
Yes! I want all the little animals to be safe and happy!
...You're really a kind little lamb.
Pengpeng's kindness, perseverance and sincerity deeply touch the originally fierce crocodile.
The originally serious look in the crocodile's eyes gradually softens. It gently nods and slowly lies on the ground.
Come on, little warrior. I'll carry you across the river!
Thank you so much, Mr. Crocodile! You're so kind!
The crocodile swims slowly, taking Pengpeng safely across the dangerous river and sending him to the other side.
Swim steadily, paddling with the limbs alternately and keeping the back stable
Stand on the crocodile's back, the body swaying slightly with the waves and the front hooves hanging naturally
Goodbye, Mr. Crocodile! I'll always remember your help!
Come on, future King of the Clouds!
He turned around resolutely and ran away into the distance, his figure gradually shrinking
--- The sacred grass chooses its master, and rules above the clouds ---
--- The seventh choice: A test of kindness ---
After successfully crossing the river, PongPong thanked the crocodile and continued walking forward.
Standing on the riverbank, watching PongPong leave and nodding slightly
Not far ahead, it met a shivering little elf beside a cold stone.
The elf had thin wings and sparse fluff. It was huddled in the corner, shivering constantly. It seemed about to be frozen stiff by the cold air in the forbidden area.
So cold... Who can help me...
This is the final test of humanity. What should PongPong do?

branches.label: Share some fur to keep the elf warm
Ignore it and don't share any fur

resources.text: Humph, you crocodile blocking the way, I'll step on you and cross!
How dare you!
I will step on you! Get out of the way quickly!
PongPong looked at the crocodile blocking the way. It was very impatient and just wanted to cross the river quickly to fulfill its dream.
It had no patience to communicate and directly stepped on the crocodile's head impatiently, trying to jump across quickly.
Roar! How dare you offend me!
Ah! It hurts so much! Help!
But the crocodile is the guardian of the river and will never tolerate being trampled on casually.
Hugging its bleeding right foot tightly with both hands, its body curled up and trembling: Wuwuwu, my foot hurts so much... I can't walk...
This is the punishment for your rudeness!
PongPong cried loudly in pain. The wound kept bleeding, and it could no longer move forward.
I don't care about you. I'm going to find the rainbow grass!
Please, help me. I'm freezing to death...
Don't bother me. I'm in a hurry!

PongPong only had one thing in mind: to find the rainbow grass quickly and become the King of the Clouds. It completely ignored the elf's plight. Without even looking at the frozen elf, it turned away coldly and walked forward in a hurry.
Since you won't help me, I have to save myself!
Ah! My fur!

On the verge of freezing to death, the elf, in order to save itself, could only use its last bit of strength to quietly fly behind Pengpeng and steal the fluff on its body. Without the warm fluff, Pengpeng was soon blown down by the cold wind in the forbidden area. Its body froze stiff, and it couldn't move forward even half a step.
[Trigger failed: Return to the main line and make a choice again]
Staggered and spun half a circle before kneeling down with a thud
Wrapped the fluff tightly around itself and turned to walk into the snowstorm
Little elf, you look so pitifully frozen! Let me help you!
Really? But I have nothing to repay you with...
No need to repay! It's right to help others!
Seeing the pitiful look of the little elf, Pengpeng immediately felt pity in its heart.
Without the slightest hesitation, it actively stretched out its little hand, gently plucked the softest and warmest fluff on its body, and carefully wrapped it around the little elf.
Little elf, don't be afraid. My fluff is very warm. I'll share some with you, and you won't be cold anymore.
Thank you! Thank you! Kind little lamb!
Pengpeng's kindness was like a warm beam of sunlight, instantly melting the cold on the little elf's body.
The little elf was so touched that tears welled up in its eyes. It tightly hugged the fluff given by Pengpeng, and its whole body was filled with strength again.
To repay you, I'll tell you a secret!
What secret?
I know the secret location of the Rainbow Grass. I'll lead the way for you!
Kind little lamb, follow me!
Okay! Thank you, little elf!
Led by the little elf, Pengpeng passed through layers of secret realms, avoided all hidden dangers, and reached the sacred place where the Rainbow Grass grew.

The legendary Rainbow Grass grew at the very top of the clouds. Its leaves emitted seven kinds of light - red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, and purple, like a rainbow in the sky falling into the grass, so beautiful that one couldn't take their eyes off it.
Wow! The Rainbow Grass! Finally found you!
Eat it quickly. You'll become the great King of the Clouds!
Pengpeng gently picked the Rainbow Grass and slowly put it into its mouth.
Its fluff became even more fluffy, and its body emitted a dazzling seven - colored light. Its strength and character were perfectly sublimated.
The body emits a dazzling seven - colored light and slowly rotates to show the transformed posture
Congratulations, child!
Congratulations, brave guardian!
Congratulations, little warrior!
At this moment, the light enveloped the earth, the clouds dispersed, and all the small animals felt the power of justice and kindness.
Pengpeng has successfully transformed into the Cloud King, revered by all and guarding the heavens and earth!
Thank you all! I will definitely use my power to protect our homeland and all kind - hearted lives!
Let peace and warmth always remain in this land!
The adventure is a complete success! Congratulations on helping Pengpeng realize his dream with kindness and wisdom!
